title: Super friendly host and great food.
text: We always love a food and walking tour to introduce us to a city and the local specialities. We were all booked and ready and then we nearly had to cancel as they didn't have enough people to run the trip. Thankfully we were offered an upgrade to do this as a personal trip and we were so glad that we did just that. Our guide, Jeff, was so friendly and knowledgeable (he's an ex-chef, so he really found stuff that was great to experience).
